stories.headline: ‘Major casualties’ feared after flash floods along Nepal-Tibet border

opening: Hundreds missing and at least 22 people dead after floods sweep away houses, roads, bridges and power projects.
Hundreds are missing and at least 22 people have died after torrential floods ⁠hit the Himalayan border areas of ⁠Nepal and in ​Tibet in China.
body: Houses, roads, bridges and power projects were swept away ⁠in Nepal while officials in Tibet said they feared “major casualties” with some missing in the county of Gyirong after a mudslide hit a land crossing between the neighbours.
